name: Camera ride along a line
what: A glowing line is drawn through five points over a dark woven ground while the camera rides its tip: it starts close on the first point, loops down and rushes up and over past a big title, then pulls back to show the whole S-shaped line with the title behind it and a second line fading in letter by letter in front.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f3-f21 a square pops out of the first point; f21-f102 the camera rides the tip (slow start, fastest f55-f71, slowing to rest on the last point at f102) at 1.6 times zoom while the points A-D are left behind at f3, f55, f64, f72; f84-f160 the camera pulls back from 1.6 to 1.0 times (fastest f131) while the colours settle to red in the middle and cold at the ends; f150-f180 the second line blurs in letter by letter; f160-f230 a slow drift of 24 px
